/outreach.title: My Framer Site
p: On July 31 and August 1, we visited the Trumbull and Derby Libraries to present FIRST programs to families and provide children with the opportunity to interact with our FLL and FTC robots. The kids built attachments for the FLL robot and drove the FTC robot around. Many families expressed interest in FIRST programs, and we recruited one FTC member from this event!
